<td style="width: 1in"><span style="text-transform: uppercase"><b>Item&#160;5.07.</b></span></td><td><span style="text-transform: uppercase"><b>Submission of Matters to a Vote of Security Holders.</b></span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 23.1pt">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 23.1pt">On May&#160;7, 2026, Ryman Hospitality Properties,
Inc. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) held its annual meeting of stockholders (the&#160;&#8220;Annual Meeting&#8221;). As of the record date
for the Annual Meeting, there were 63,109,272 shares of the Company&#8217;s common stock outstanding and entitled to vote on all matters
presented to the Company&#8217;s stockholders at the Annual Meeting. Holders of 59,147,731 shares of the Company&#8217;s common stock
were present in person or represented by proxy at the Annual Meeting. The following proposals were voted on and approved by the Company&#8217;s
stockholders at the Annual Meeting:</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 23.1pt">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>MANAGEMENT PROPOSALS:</b></p>
